newsitem.title: FRANCE: Officials detail results of EU grain tender.
newsitem.headline: Officials detail results of EU grain tender.

text.p: The European Union on Thursday granted exports of 311,650 tonnes of soft wheat from the open market at a maximum refund of 6.0 Ecus per tonne, member country officials said.
It also granted exports of 235,300 tonnes of open-market barley at a maximum refund of 30.98 Ecus, they said.

EU delegates meeting in Brussels also granted 21,375 tonnes of open-market soft wheat at a maximum refund of 10.0 Ecus per tonne in a separate export tender for African, Caribbean and Pacific countries, they said.
The 70 or so nations eligible for the wheat are tied to the EU through Lome preferential trade accords.
The EU also granted 80,700 tonnes of free-market rye at a maximum refund of 30.0 Ecus per tonne, the officials said.
The EU rejected bids for subsidies to export oats from the open market.
There were no intervention sales, with little available for export and German authorities closed for the day.
